sections.title: Introduction: The Goal of Clarity
lecture_lines: Effective explanations bridge logic to learner schemas.
We use the 3C framework for clarity.
Clarity, Connection, and Completeness anchor concepts.
animations: Display title: 'Introduction: The Goal of Clarity' in #FFFFFF color.
Fade in a central lightbulb graphic icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg] in #FFFF00.
Pulse the lightbulb graphic [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg] to emphasize the 'Clarity' goal.

sections.title: Criterion 1: Logical Sequencing (Prerequisite Scaffolding)
lecture_lines: Introduce simple blocks before abstract complex forms.
Linear dependency shapes deep cognitive structure.
animations: Animate a series of three connected building blocks [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blocks.svg] appearing sequentially in #00FFFF.
Highlight the connections between the blocks in #FF00FF to emphasize scaffolding.

sections.title: Criterion 2: Multi-Modal Representation
lecture_lines: Dual-coding unites verbal and visual channels.
Represent objects through dynamic transformation animations.
Function machines make abstract math concrete.
animations: Simultaneously animate a graph, a formula, a geometric shape, and the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/machine.svg] (all #FFFFFF).
Blink each element in #FF00FF to highlight the multi-modal nature, including the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/machine.svg].

sections.title: Criterion 3: Relatability and Application
lecture_lines: Relatability anchors concepts in long-term memory.
Connect abstract math to real-world scenarios.
Squirrel climbing trees models velocity rates.
animations: Animate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/gear.svg] transitioning into an abstract formula in #00FF00.
Use a smooth morphing animation to show the 'Application' connection.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Feedback Loop
lecture_lines: Check for understanding completes the loop.
Learners must reconstruct the logic themselves.
animations: Display title: 'Conclusion: The Feedback Loop' in #FFFFFF.
Draw a circular arrow loop icon in #FFFF00.
Animate a dot moving continuously along the circular loop path.
